x2.description: A twiny's value axis (shares y with the panel).

y2.description: A twinx's value axis (shares x with the panel).

presets.description: Per-role build-animation hints, keyed by role (a consumer may override everything).

insetOf.description: The panel this panel is an inset of (ax.inset_axes).

colorScales.description: Portable colour scales, one per colour-control key; see definitions/colorScale.

style.description: The theme in force at save: its name (null once the rcParams were changed by hand) and the scaffold colours by token (ink, label, tick, axis, grid, plot, paper), which data-ink-fill / data-ink-stroke on scaffold elements refer to.

quality.description: Lint findings recorded at save (fp.save(lint=...)): quality.color lists colorcheck findings.

idAliases.description: Ids an older fluxplot gave the same parts: old id (or old id prefix, for a series root) → current id. Resolve saved overrides through it; kept for one minor version after a rename.

figure.description: Figure-scope parts (unprefixed ids): the suptitle, sup-labels, figure legends, fig.text annotations and the figure's own extra artists.

secondary.description: A secondary axis: samples of the parent → secondary transform.

normalization.description: A matplotlib norm by class name (alias of colorScales[].norm, whose kind is portable).

cmapSpec.description: How the recipe names the map: a resolvable name, or the portable {lut, under, over, bad} table.

field.description: A colour-mapped mark's source-data colour contract (the portable law is colorScales[field.colorScale]).

signatureStats.description: fp.glowbar / fp.fluxbox payload: part=summary carries the statistics drawn for a category; part=unit a unit's identity.

hexmatrix.description: fp.hexmatrix payload: the lattice, the statistic and every hexagon drawn.

surface.description: fp.surface payload: the complete value→colour contract of a surface (brain) map and every part.

data.description: The series' numbers as plotted; xLabels / yLabels name the category behind each on a categorical axis, xIso / yIso the ISO-8601 instant on a date axis.

valueMorph.description: Members carry stable keys (data-key): two versions can be tweened member by member.

groupId.description: Manifest-only id of this series' member group when svgId is a collection shared with other series (seaborn hue splits).

color.description: The series' colour: hex = its primary paint (or 'varies' for a colour-mapped collection), alpha, token = the exact palette token naming it, palette = its position in the active cycle, scale = the colorScales[] id colouring it.

keys.description: Stable per-bar keys (the category label under each bar); also data-key on the bar element.

band.description: An area's inputs: fp.band records {x, lo, hi, what}, fp.area {x, y1, y2}; a promoted fill_between only its polygon paths.

uncertainty.description: An errorbar's errors broadcast to the N points: xerr / yerr are N values, or [lower, upper] (each N) when errShape is asymmetric.

image.description: An fp.image: its channels (each a colorScales[] entry, <series>.<channel>), LUTs, display ranges, pixel size and extent.

axis.description: Present when the series is drawn against a twin's value axis (axes[].y2 / .x2).

stats.description: The test behind a significance bracket (fp.brackets): the fp.stats row it was drawn from.

length.description: A scale bar's length in data units.

partNode.description: A parts-tree node: a leaf (ref + role), a group (id, members, groupRole / memberRole) or a container (id, children).

alpha.description: A second, opacity channel (alpha_by): each element's fill-opacity runs over range with its data-alpha-value under norm.

colorScale.description: A portable colour scale (colorscale.py): the exact lookup table and norm of every colour-mapped mark, the svg groups it colours and the colour keys drawing it. The id equals the recipe's colour-control key.
